title: Shape optimization of light structures with general Hooke's laws
summary: For the minimum-compliance shape optimization problem it was established recently [\textit{Duke Math.\ J.} 172 (2023), 43--103] that a sequence of approximately optimal shapes of exact volume \(\e\) converges to a limiting generalized shape, which is represented by a possibly diffuse probability measure, as \(\e \todown 0\). This generalized shape minimizes the so-called light-structures compliance functional, which --- as conjectured by Bouchitté --- is expressed in terms of a relaxed integrand, reflecting that optimal shapes must only involve ``lower-dimensional'' structures, like the…
